name: ls
description: List information about the FILEs (the current directory by default). Sort entries alphabetically if none of -cftuvSUX nor --sort is specified.

options.description: Use a long listing format showing permissions, links, owner, size, and timestamp.
Do not ignore entries starting with . (hidden files).
With -l and -s, print sizes like 1K, 234M, 2G etc.
Sort by modification time, newest first.

examples.title: Basic listing
examples.explanation: Lists files and directories in the current working directory in brief format.

examples.title: Detailed listing with hidden files
examples.output:
total 32
drwxr-xr-x  6 user user 4096 Oct 12 10:00 .
drwxr-xr-x 20 user user 4096 Oct 12 09:30 ..
-rw-r--r--  1 user user  220 Oct 12 09:30 .bashrc
drwxr-xr-x  2 user user 4096 Oct 12 09:45 Documents
examples.explanation: Shows detailed file attributes including hidden dotfiles.

examples.title: Human readable sizes sorted by time
examples.output:
total 12M
-rw-r--r-- 1 user user 12M Oct 12 10:02 archive.tar.gz
-rw-r--r-- 1 user user 4K Oct 12 09:50 notes.txt
examples.explanation: Combines long listing, human-readable file sizes, and newest-first sorting.

useCases: Checking file permissions and modification dates
